profile.headline: Sr. Staff software engineer, Five9
profile.summary:
I have over two decades of experience working in communications, distributed signalling systems, platform architecture, software development, and VoIP.  I have built and scaled up distributed SIP platforms utilizing virtualization systems, and am co-author of the patent, "System and method for geographic SIP scaling".  

I am interested in architectures that are auto scaling and distributed.  I have practical experience in many languages, distributed databases, and message queuing systems.  I have a deep technical expertise in VoIP, SIP, the RFC's surrounding SIP and it's extensions, as well as the software ecosystems that facilitate delivering VoIP as a service, at the class 4 carrier level, and class 5 end user service level.
